                                                                  COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                                                     Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184        Document 1     Filed 09/25/25   Page 2 of 10



 1         Plaintiff Nerdwallet, Inc. (“Nerdwallet”) alleges as follows:
 2                                 NATURE OF THE ACTION
 3         1.        This actions seeks to hold Defendant Fidelity Information Services,
 4   LLC, d/b/a Atelio (“Atelio”) accountable for its failure to perform straightforward
 5   contractual obligations, which have caused NerdWallet to suffer both monetary and
 6   reputational harm.
 7         2.        NerdWallet, a leading consumer finance company, engaged Atelio to
 8   manage the start-up, operation and, ultimately, wind-down of the NerdUp Card, a
 9   secured credit card launched in October 2023, with the goal of helping consumers
10   build credit.
11         3.        Atelio’s responsibilities in connection with the wind-down of the
12   NerdUp Card could not have been simpler. Its core job was to issue refund checks to
13   a little over 1,600 customers who had not withdrawn their funds from their connected
14   bank accounts.
15         4.        Atelio failed at every turn. Despite agreeing to issue all refunds by April
16   2025, it has yet to complete the process.
17         5.        Even when Atelio attempted to issue refunds, many of the checks were
18   invalid. In fact, one customer received four invalid checks from Atelio.
19         6.        Making matters worse, Atelio attempted to cover its tracks by repeatedly
20   ignoring NerdWallet’s requests for additional information.
21         7.        NerdWallet has attempted to work with Atelio to rectify the situation,
22   but Atelio has refused to cooperate at every turn. As a result, NerdWallet has suffered
23   substantial losses, including, but not limited to, increased business costs, increased
24   litigation and regulatory risks (including two monetary settlements to date to avoid
25   threatened litigation), and serious reputational harm.
26                                JURISDICTION AND VENUE
27         8.        This Court has original jurisdiction over this matter pursuant to 28
28   U.S.C. § 1332 because NerdWallet has its principal place of business in California,
                                                                       COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                                 -2-                        Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184       Document 1    Filed 09/25/25   Page 3 of 10



 1   no Defendant resides in California, and the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000.
 2         9.     Venue is proper in this District under 28 U.S.C. § 1391 because a
 3   substantial part of the events or omissions giving rise to NerdWallet’s claims
 4   occurred here and NerdWallet resides in this District.
 5                                          PARTIES
 6         10.        NerdWallet, Inc. (“NerdWallet”) is a leading personal finance company
 7   incorporated in the state of Delaware and with its principal place of business in San
 8   Mateo, California.
 9         11.    Fidelity Information Services, LLC, d/b/a Atelio (“Atelio”) is a financial
10   technology company organized under the laws of the State of Arkansas and with its
11   principal place of business in Jacksonville, Florida.
12         12.    Atelio is a wholly owned subsidiary of Fidelity National Information
13   Services, Inc., a Fortune 500 company that bills itself as a leading global provider of
14   financial technology solutions. Atelio regularly and systematically conducts business
15   in California.
16                                FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS
17         13.    NerdWallet engaged Atelio in June of 2023 to provide certain services
18   in connection with the NerdUp Card.
19         14.    The NerdUp Card allowed users to build credit with minimal risk by
20   depositing funds in an account and using those funds to cover their future NerdUp
21   Card purchases.
22         15.    NerdWallet and Atelio’s relationship was principally governed by the
23   Terms of Use executed by the parties on or about June 3, 2023.
24         16.    Under the Terms of Use, Atelio had primary responsibility for most
25   aspects of the NerdUp Card’s operations, including issuing cards; creating and
26   maintaining an online application for customers; servicing and supporting customers’
27   accounts; managing the relationship with the bank holding the customers’ deposit
28   accounts; and handling collection activities on past-due accounts.
                                                                   COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                                -3-                     Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184       Document 1      Filed 09/25/25   Page 4 of 10



 1         17.      Atelio further agreed to use commercially reasonable efforts to address
 2   customer issues and assist NerdWallet during the wind-down process.
 3         18.      NerdWallet relied on Atelio to perform its contractual obligations
 4   competently and in good faith. Indeed, Atelio expressly represented and warranted
 5   that the services it provided would materially conform to the Terms of Use, and it
 6   agreed to indemnify NerdWallet against “any” loss resulting from its breach of those
 7   representations and warranties or its wind-down obligations.
 8         19.      In the fall of 2024, NerdWallet opted to discontinue the NerdUp Card.
 9   As such, on November 22, 2024, NerdWallet and Atelio executed an Addendum to
10   the Terms of Use, reiterating their commitment to cooperate on the closure of the
11   program and agreeing to effectuate a “Wind-Down Plan.”
12         20.      The wind-down of the NerdUp Card was not a complex undertaking.
13   Atelio had a few, simple responsibilities. Namely, Atelio agreed to:
14                     a. Disable NerdUp Cards, and prevent further deposits or
15               withdrawals, on the “freeze date” of February 17, 2025.
16                     b. Issue refund checks to customers who did not withdraw their
17               funds before the freeze date.
18                     c. Request NerdWallet’s cooperation “in a timely manner” if such
19               cooperation was needed to effectuate refunds.
20                     d. Deliver final statements to users.
21                     e. Complete its wind-down obligations by an agreed April 21, 2025
22               Closure Date.
23         21.      For its part, NerdWallet agreed to provide notice to impacted customers,
24   cooperate in the return of funds to customers if needed, and continue to provide
25   customer support for 90 days after the NerdUp Card’s agreed closure date of April
26   21, 2025.
27                        Atelio Botches the NerdUp Card Wind-Down
28         22.      Atelio did one thing right under the Wind-Down Plan: it successfully
                                                                     COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                                 -4-                      Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184      Document 1      Filed 09/25/25   Page 5 of 10



 1   disabled NerdUp Cards and user accounts on the February 17, 2025 freeze date.
 2   Otherwise, it has completely failed to live up to its contractual obligations.
 3           23.   Put mildly, Atelio’s performance has been a disaster.
 4                                      Payment Delays
 5           24.   Most fundamental, Atelio failed to fulfill its obligation to timely issue
 6   refunds to a little over 1,600 NerdUp customers.
 7           25.   At the time of the freeze date, there were only 1,609 customers who had
 8   not withdrawn their deposits and needed refunds.
 9           26.   Despite agreeing to issue all refunds by April 21, 2025, Atelio has failed
10   to do so. In fact, Atelio expressly represented that the entire refund process would be
11   completed by the end of March 2025, yet Atelio did not send out a single check until
12   April 14, 2025. In other words, NerdUp customers did not begin receiving refunds
13   until after the entire refund process was scheduled to be completed.
14           27.   Worse    yet,   additional   checks    (including     replacement      checks
15   necessitated by Atelio’s payment and communication failures described below) have
16   been issued at a snail’s pace.
17           28.   Nearly five months after the freeze date, the refund process still has not
18   been completed, in plain breach of Atelio’s obligation to timely issue refund checks.
19                                      Rejected Checks
20           29.   Even in those instances where Atelio managed to deliver checks, many
21   NerdUp Card customers were still unable to access their funds because the checks
22   they received were rejected by their banks.
23           30.   Atelio never notified NerdWallet that it had issued invalid checks.
24   Instead, NerdWallet discovered the issue after customers began complaining in April
25   2025.
26           31.   Atelio’s actions are inexcusable. Even after Atelio attempted to issue
27   replacement checks, it still could not get it right. One customer had four separate
28   checks rejected by his bank.
                                                                       COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                                -5-                         Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184      Document 1   Filed 09/25/25   Page 6 of 10



 1                         Failure to Communicate with NerdWallet
 2         32.   The consequences of Atelio’s recurring failures to make timely (or,
 3   often, any) refunds to NerdUp Card customers have been compounded by its failure
 4   to promptly and competently communicate with NerdWallet.
 5         33.   The Terms of Use require Atelio to reasonably assist NerdWallet with
 6   issues that arise with Atelio’s services and to resolve consumer complaints.
 7         34.   Similarly, the Wind-Down Plan requires Atelio to timely notify
 8   NerdWallet of issues with the refund process. Yet Atelio has kept NerdWallet in the
 9   dark about numerous key issues.
10         35.   After sending the initial round of refund checks through standard mail,
11   Atelio did not in any way track the status or delivery of those refunds. It was only
12   through customer complaints that NerdWallet discovered that numerous customers
13   had not received their checks after weeks of waiting.
14         36.   The same is true for the bad checks that Atelio sent: NerdWallet
15   discovered these issues through customer complaints, not from Atelio.
16         37.   And despite repeated inquiries about the status of the refund process,
17   Atelio has continuously refused to provide updates or meaningfully communicate.
18         38.   Even today, Atelio refuses to keep NerdWallet apprised of the status of
19   the refund process.
20                                     Statement Errors
21         39.   Atelio even failed in performing the rudimentary task of issuing account
22   statements to customers.
23         40.   Atelio notified NerdWallet on April 11, 2025, that it miscalculated the
24   statement balances for at least five customers. But NerdWallet’s attempts to
25   communicate with these customers were delayed for more than a month because
26   Atelio initially provided NerdWallet with incorrect user IDs.
27         41.   Atelio has no justification for its failures. NerdWallet contracted with
28   Atelio to service the NerdUp Card and cooperate on its wind-down. Atelio has
                                                                  COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                             -6-                       Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184     Document 1     Filed 09/25/25   Page 7 of 10



 1   completely failed to perform these straightforward obligations.
 2                    Atelio’s Breaches Have Caused Substantial Harm
 3         42.    NerdWallet paid Atelio hundreds of thousands of dollars in connection
 4   with the NerdUp Card program.
 5         43.    Atelio’s numerous, material breaches of the Terms of Use and the Wind-
 6   Down Plan (including but not limited to its breach of its representations and
 7   warranties in Section 14 of the Terms of Use and its wind-down obligations in
 8   Section 19 of the Terms of Use) have deprived NerdWallet of the benefit of its
 9   bargain and caused substantial other harm, including, but not limited to, increased
10   operating costs, heightened litigation and regulatory risks, and reputational harm.
11         44.    Atelio’s failure to properly repay NerdUp Card customers caused a
12   protracted and continuing surge in customer complaints directed at NerdWallet.
13         45.    NerdWallet’s support obligations under the Wind-Down Plan ended on
14   July 20, 2025, 90 days after the closure date. Yet, to date, NerdWallet continues to
15   field complaints from NerdUp Card customers whose refunds were delayed, or who
16   never received refunds. In fact, NerdWallet has fielded more than 1,000 consumer
17   complaints related to the NerdUp Card since the freeze date.
18         46.    The volume and duration of these complaints required NerdWallet to
19   devote additional staff and resources for far longer than anticipated, increasing costs
20   and impairing NerdWallet’s ability to address other customer issues.
21         47.    Atelio’s failure to timely comply with its refund obligations has also
22   caused heightened regulatory and litigation risk. Given the real-world harm caused
23   by Atelio’s failure to timely make refunds, customers foreseeably escalated their
24   complaints beyond NerdWallet, including to the Consumer Financial Protection
25   Bureau and the Bureau Better Business Bureau.
26         48.    To avoid the risk and expense of litigation, NerdWallet has reached
27   monetary settlements in two instances, and it faces an ongoing risk of litigation,
28   increased regulatory attention, and other retaliatory action.
                                                                     COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                               -7-                        Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184      Document 1     Filed 09/25/25   Page 8 of 10



 1         49.    Atelio’s failures have also damaged NerdWallet’s reputation.
 2   NerdWallet’s business depends on the trust and goodwill of its customers, which is
 3   why NerdWallet goes to great lengths to protect its reputation.
 4         50.    Atelio’s handling of the NerdUp Card wind-down has tarnished that
 5   reputation. Consumers neither understand nor care that Atelio, rather than
 6   NerdWallet, is at fault for failing to return their money. Instead, they understandably
 7   blame the company whose name is on the credit card—NerdWallet. But it Atelio, not
 8   NerdWallet, that failed to live up to its obligations.
 9                              FIRST CLAIM FOR RELIEF
10                                   (Breach Of Contract)
11         51.    NerdWallet realleges and incorporates herein by reference each and
12   every forgoing paragraph as if set forth in full.
13         52.    NerdWallet and Atelio entered into a valid, enforceable contract (the
14   Terms of Use and Wind-Down Plan) for the provision of services in connection with
15   the NerdUp Card and its wind-down.
16         53.    Atelio materially breached its obligations under the Terms of Use and
17   Wind-Down Plan in numerous ways, including by failing to timely issue refunds to
18   consumers, issuing defective and uncashable checks, failing to adequately
19   communicate with NerdWallet regarding the refund process, failing to issue proper
20   statements, and failing to exercise its obligations competently and in good faith.
21         54.    Atelio’s material breaches of contract have damaged NerdWallet,
22   including by depriving it of the benefit of its bargain and causing substantial other
23   harm, including increased operating costs, heightened litigation and regulatory risks,
24   reputational harm, and costs, fees (including attorneys’ fees), and expenses.
25         55.    Based on the foregoing, Atelio is liable to NerdWallet for breach of
26   contract, and NerdWallet entitled to an award of damages of not less than $1 million.
27

28
                                                                   COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                               -8-                      Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
         Case 3:25-cv-08184          Document 1   Filed 09/25/25   Page 9 of 10



 1                                  SECOND CLAIM FOR RELIEF
 2                                        (Indemnification)
 3         56.       NerdWallet incorporates each of the foregoing paragraphs as if fully set
 4   forth herein.
 5         57.       Atelio represented and warranted that it would carry out its obligations
 6   materially in accordance with the Terms of Use and would cooperate with
 7   NerdWallet in winding down the NerdUp Card program.
 8         58.       Atelio agreed to indemnify NerdWallet against “any” loss resulting
 9   from its breach of its representations and warranties and its obligations in connection
10   with the wind-down.
11         59.       Atelio’s material breaches of contract have damaged NerdWallet,
12   including by depriving it of the benefit of its bargain and causing substantial other
13   harm, including increased operating costs, heightened litigation and regulatory risks,
14   reputational harm, and other costs, fees (including attorneys’ fees), and expenses.
15         60.       Based on the foregoing, Atelio must indemnify NerdWallet for all losses
16   it has incurred as a result of Atelio’s breaches of its representations and warranties,
17   including settlements reached with NerdUp customers, as well as all damages and
18   costs caused by Atelio’s failure to complete the wind-down .
19                                  DEMAND FOR JURY TRIAL
20         61.       NerdWallet demands a jury trial on all issues triable of right by jury.
21                                    PRAYER FOR RELIEF
22   WHEREFORE, NerdWallet prays for the following relief:
23         a. A determination that Atelio breached the Terms of Use and Wind-Down
24               Plan;
25         b. A determination that Atelio must indemnify NerdWallet for all losses
26               sustained as a result of its breach of its representations and warranties;
27         c. An award of compensatory and consequential damages in an amount to be
28               proved at trial;
                                                                      COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES
                                                 -9-                       Case No. 3:25-cv-08184
        Case 3:25-cv-08184     Document 1     Filed 09/25/25   Page 10 of 10



 1         d. An award of costs, expenses, attorneys’ fees, and other losses incurred as a
 2            result of NerdWallet’s breaches;
 3         e. An award of pre- and post-judgment interest as permitted by law and
 4            contract;
 5         f. Any other relief that the Court finds just or appropriate.
 6
